title: transit admin GET /stats silently returns 0 for articles due to wrong pool
description: transit/src/admin.rs build_stats_json queries msgid_map and pinned_cids on transit_pool, but those tables live in the core pool (transit_core.db). Failures are swallowed with unwrap_or(0). Production operators see articles:0 even with thousands ingested. Maintenance consequence: silent wrong data, hard to debug, will fool monitoring.
